manual.shaders.line2: Shaders are items you can find in the world or aquire by trading with villagers.{0}
manual.shaders.line3: They don't have a purpose by themselves, but they can be equipped to {0}Revolvers{1}, {2}Drills{3}, {4}Chemical Throwers{5}, {6}Heavy Plated Shields{7}, {8}Railguns{9}, and {10}Accumulator Backpacks{11} (and possibly other things you still have to discover) to change the designs of the item.{12}
manual.shaders.line4: Simply put the item in an {0}Engineer's Workbench{1} and equip the shader in the appropriate slot.{2}
manual.shaders.line5: You can also apply them to a Minecart, Banner or a {0}Balloon{1} by rightclicking!{2}
manual.shaders.line6: For a full list of all available shaders, their looks, references and more details, {0}check here{1}{2}
manual.shaders.line7: {0}Shader Grabbags are items containing a random shader.  They can be found in crates, traded from villagers or dropped by bosses.{1}
manual.shaders.line8: The rarity of the contained shader is equal to, or better than the rarity of the bag.{0}
manual.shaders.line9: When using a bag, you are more likely to get a shader you do not yet own than one you already possess.{0}
manual.shaders.line10: Shaders bags can be crafted into two bags of a lower level. This will lower your chances of getting rarer shaders but provide you with more attempts.
